title: Prove editor performance, accessibility, and crash recovery
summary: Produce release- or local-use-grade evidence: measure pan, zoom, hit testing, selection, large boards, memory, save, reopen, migration, crash recovery, keyboard, and VoiceOver.
acceptance_criteria: Prove the measured outcome: measure pan, zoom, hit testing, selection, large boards, memory, save, reopen, migration, crash recovery, keyboard, and VoiceOver.
Create a revision-pinned verification plan linking claims, invariants, risk, methods, and evidence.
Measure a baseline before setting or enforcing numeric budgets.
Record host or device, OS, architecture, toolchain, configuration, data fixture, sample count, distribution, and limitations.
Distinguish static, unit, integration, fixture, simulator, device, hardware, staging, distributed, and real-use evidence.
Verify the flagship journey and its highest-risk failure and recovery paths.
Measure launch or startup, critical interaction or command latency, memory, storage, network or I/O, and long-run stability as appropriate.
Measure accessibility and localization behavior in relevant runtimes.
Verify privacy, security, entitlement, billing, ads, filesystem, hardware, or external-service constraints where applicable.
Attempt to falsify at least one critical claim through adversarial review.
Use an independent reviewer for high-risk or critical behavior.
Record stale, blocked, unavailable, not-run, and not-applicable evidence separately.
Define evidence invalidation triggers for source, dependency, toolchain, configuration, fixture, and requirement changes.
Define a repeatable regression sentinel or local re-verification command.
Verify cancellation, timeout, retry, rollback, recovery, or safe stop.
Compare result changes without attributing causality unsupported by evidence.
Record all app-owned warnings as failures unless a narrow unexpired exception exists.
Produce a human-readable proof report and machine-readable evidence artifact.
Update release or local-use readiness only when evidence supports it.
Do not release, deploy, sign, upload, or mutate external systems in this ticket.
Finish with zero app-owned warnings.
